description: Declared downstream technology families that an entry's `unlocks` may point at. Created in response to run-001-baseline, which falsified H002: all 15 unlock targets in the corpus resolved to nothing, so build_graph.py was drawing edges to invented nodes and the unlocks_lineage criterion was counting strings. An unlock target must now be either another keystone id (a direct descent claim) or a term declared here (a family claim). Adding a term is cheap; adding it silently is what this file prevents.

terms.name: Climate-resilient agriculture
terms.description: Cultivation designed to hold yield through the variability it expects rather than the average it hopes for.

terms.name: Drought resilience
terms.description: Practices that carry a population through predictable subsistence failure.

terms.name: Landscape engineering
terms.description: Modification of hydrology, fire regime, or terrain at watershed scale.

terms.name: Managed aquaculture
terms.description: Deliberate husbandry of aquatic species through built water infrastructure.

terms.name: Community insurance
terms.description: Pooled liability against individual shock, underwritten by membership rather than by premium.

terms.name: Non-market exchange
terms.description: Circulation of goods governed by obligation rather than price.

terms.name: Regional trust networks
terms.description: Standing relationships that make exchange safe across political boundaries.

terms.name: Reputation systems
terms.description: Durable public record of conduct used to price trust.

terms.name: Wealth redistribution
terms.description: Mechanisms that move accumulated surplus back down a gradient before it hardens into permanent rank.

terms.name: Binding pacifism
terms.description: Renunciation of lethal force enforced as law rather than urged as virtue.

terms.name: Conflict ritualization
terms.description: Channelling dispute into bounded contest that terminates before killing.

terms.name: Intergenerational covenants
terms.description: Commitments binding on people who did not consent to them and cannot renegotiate.

terms.name: Relational AI ethics
terms.description: Ethics grounded in the quality of relationships between agents rather than in rules applied to isolated actors. The only forward-looking term here, and the one most likely to need revision.

terms.name: Veto ethics
terms.description: Structural power to block, held by those who bear a decision's cost.

terms.name: Distributed governance protocols
terms.description: Procedures letting autonomous units reach binding joint decisions without surrendering autonomy to a centre.

terms.name: Resilient accounting
terms.description: Record systems that remain auditable after institutional collapse.

terms.name: Household utilities
terms.description: Service delivery terminating inside the dwelling rather than at a public point.

terms.name: Modular urbanism
terms.description: Cities composed of repeatable units that can be extended without redesign.

terms.name: Public health infrastructure
terms.description: Built systems whose function is population-scale disease reduction.

terms.name: Sedentary forager settlement
terms.description: Permanent settlement supported without domesticated staple crops.

terms.name: Industrial mass production
terms.description: Interchangeable parts manufactured to tolerance at volume.

terms.name: Distributed risk pooling
terms.description: Spreading subsistence shock across a network wider than the co-resident group.

terms.name: Mutual aid networks
terms.description: Reciprocal support obligations maintained outside kinship and outside the state.

terms.name: Social safety nets
terms.description: Standing obligations that catch a person whose own household has failed, before destitution is reached.

revision_note: Nine terms removed in the merge with main: regenerative_agriculture, carbon_sequestration, circular_waste_systems, low_bandwidth_data, tactile_coding, federalism_templates, consensus_protocols, machine_tools_family, and precision_engineering were promoted to full keystone entries on that branch. An encoded entry beats a vocabulary stub, and holding both would give one id two definitions — H002 now fails on that collision rather than letting the graph pick a winner silently. Six terms added for targets that main's new entries left dangling.
